result:
I updated `src/exports/links.ts`:

- `DownloadLink` now has `expiresAt: string`.
- `createDownloadLink` sets `expiresAt` to 7 days after creation, as an ISO 8601 string.
- The URL now includes it as `?token=...&expires=<expiresAt>`, URL-encoded.

Nothing else in the codebase uses `DownloadLink` or `createDownloadLink`, so no other code needed changes. I haven't run or type-checked it.

This only adds the expiry to the link. Nothing checks `expires` when the link is used, so the server that serves the download still has to reject expired links. The `expires` value is also plain in the URL, so someone could edit it unless the server signs it or compares it against its own stored expiry.
